evidence: The head of a real Codex 0.145.0 rollout that STARTS with `compacted` (#1393; 82 local files have this shape, and 0 of 2,579 have a session_meta after a conversation record): session_meta, the compacted line, world_state and turn_context. Its replacement_history holds 8 retained user items (one of them the Codex bootstrap: AGENTS.md preamble plus environment_context), 2 developer items and an encrypted compaction item, and no earlier conversation record exists in the file. Keys, types, roles, timestamps, the CLI version and uuid ids are verbatim; every other string is replaced by the same number of x characters, except the bootstrap marker prefixes (`# AGENTS.md instructions for `, `<environment_context`) that the mapper recognises.
